label: Effect-local esse-or-mode weakening of perfection-as-mode for perfection transfer (#1789)
summary: Persists the 2026-11-19 findings posted on issue #1789. They were checked only by a standalone JavaScript relation evaluator: no Lean, Comparator or corpus result certifies any of them. (1) Logical weakening. In the conditional derivation of b26c10a0 from 5e281daf, 2f6b9eff and 791fa216 (theorem universalCauseTransfers), the global premise 791fa216 (InAct x r -> ModeOfBeing x r) can be replaced by the constructive effect-local classification EffectLocalEsseOrMode: for a universal esse cause c, a distinct x with CausesIn c x esse and InAct x r gives r = esse or ModeOfBeing x r. The esse branch is closed by the antecedent CausesIn c x esse itself. The proof sketch is uncompiled. The classification avoids deciding r = esse, which the zero-axiom Comparator of the existing result forbids; the earlier r != esse sketch used Classical.choice. Exhaustive enumeration of all 1,048,576 assignments on two beings and two respects found no counterexample to the implication. 20,944 of those assignments satisfy the other inputs and the weaker condition while falsifying the global and effect-local InAct -> ModeOfBeing forms. So the weakening is strict in that signature. (2) Sense discriminator. A shared three-being, three-respect assignment (root, producer, recipient; esse, skill, powerToProduceSkill) evaluates InAct under the formal and the inclusive formal-or-virtual readings of DISAMB-IN-ACT. Under the formal reading the esse-or-mode classification and the transfer conclusion hold. Under the inclusive reading both fail, at the producer's virtual skill. Virtual possession of skill is a mode only under a different respect index (power to produce skill), so a same-respect transport adapter is missing. (3) Concurrence control. With God(root), the universal esse cause, the total-cause premise 5e281daf, the formal-reading classification, ActualityOnlyInsofarAsBeing, PerfectionsOfEffectPreexistInCauseReading, the q.105 a.5 reading CreatedAgentIsAppliedToActByGodReading (only: some respect in which the created agent is moved) and MoverCausesWhatItMovesTo all true in a nonvacuous model, 2f6b9eff and b26c10a0 both fail at (root, recipient, skill). The present encodings do not derive the root's contribution to a secondary agent's particular effect. This is an entailment failure of the current Lean readings, not a critique of Aquinas's full q.105 a.5 argument.
blocker: The weakening relocates the remaining obstacle to 2f6b9eff (a total cause of being causes each mode of being). The secondary-only conservationist rival satisfies the weakened bundle while falsifying the transfer, and the current q.105 a.5 reading does not select the root as the mover of the secondary's particular operation. Under the inclusive InAct reading a different-respect virtual-power adapter is also required.
